exposure: somatic conditions (sleep, gastrointestinal, and sensory abnormalities)
cohort: This study investigated self-injurious behaviours in 692 children with autism spectrum disorder participating in the Study to Explore Early Development.
finding: This study found associations between self-injurious behaviors in children with autism spectrum disorder and maternal age, mode of delivery, adaptive skills, somatic conditions, other behavioral problems, child sex, gestational age, and maternal race.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with current self-injurious behaviors in children with autism spectrum disorder.
